label: The Weibull plot
subgoals: Take the log of minus the log of the survival fraction
Plot it against the log of time
Read the slope as beta and the zero crossing as eta

label: The shape from two points
subgoals: Compute the plotted ordinate at both failure fractions
Divide the ordinate difference by the log-time difference
Prefer maximum likelihood when units are censored

label: Plotting positions
subgoals: Sort the failure times and number them
Compute i minus 0.3 over n plus 0.4 for each
Avoid plotting positions that put the last failure at one
